title: Duckling dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- duckling body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#FFE66D' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- wing left -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#FFC300' transform='rotate(-20 30 62)'/>
  <!-- wing right raised -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='52' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#FFC300' transform='rotate(35 72 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='52' rx='8' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(35 72 52)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='16' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#FFF0A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#FF9F1C'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#FF9F1C'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3' fill='#2E1A47'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='3' fill='#2E1A47'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 42 Q50 48 54 42 Z' fill='#FF7A00'/>
  <path d='M46 42 Q50 45 54 42' fill='none' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- little tuft -->
  <path d='M48 23 Q50 16 54 22 Q51 19 50 23' fill='#FFC300'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M42 84 L38 94 L32 94' fill='none' stroke='#FF7A00' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M58 84 L64 92 L70 90' fill='none' stroke='#FF7A00' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- dance motion lines -->
  <path d='M22 48 Q18 44 22 40' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 38 Q82 34 80 28' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M84 58 Q88 54 86 48' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M16 66 Q12 62 14 56' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='24' r='3' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <path d='M85 24 L85 14' fill='none' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <path d='M18 34 L18 26' fill='none' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
